rows.name: Now you can return with your head held high, Melia-sama.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Indeed. Thank you, Donga.[XENO:n ]
My thanks for your gracious help.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]No, thanks to you, peace in Makna was[XENO:n ]
preserved-mo. We Nopon should thank you-ja-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Chief Donga is very fond of Melia.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT22 ]Same Hom Hom, different world.[XENO:n ]
Not fair if you ask me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Will you kindly grant these Homs passage[XENO:n ]
to Eryth Sea? It is my promise to them.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Of course-ja-mo. They are the ones who lent[XENO:n ]
us their strength in defeating the Dinobeast too.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Besides, it is a request[XENO:n ]
from Melia-sama-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
I'll inform my superiors at once-ja-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT3 ]You are too kind.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]The Chief has spoken.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

You should depart for Eryth Sea at once.[XENO:n ]
Prepare your things and see me when you are ready.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
